description: This file defines the ApplicationInfo class used to represent launchable applications within an Android environment. The class includes properties such as title, intent, icon, and filtered status, along with methods for setting up intents and overriding equality and hash code behaviors.

classes.name: ApplicationInfo
classes.description: A class representing a launchable application, providing its title, intent, icon, and filtering status, with methods to create intents and compare instances.

methods.name: setActivity
methods.description: Initializes the intent property with a new intent for launching the specified component, applying the provided launch flags.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare ApplicationInfo objects based on the title and the class name of their intent's component.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hashCode method to generate a hash based on the title and component class name.
